value.rationale: The model measures optimal uniform orbit convergence on the canonical fractional-power spectral source ball for nonuniformly stable positive Hilbert contractions. Its exact log-periodic amplitude and arithmetic two-ladder cluster set are structural dynamical invariants of gap geometry, quantified uniformly for all b>1 and alpha>0. The dyadic versus dyadic-plus-3/2 example raises the attainable lower amplitude from approximately 0.34657 to 0.36041 while keeping the same upper amplitude, showing a meaningful effect of spectral enrichment. These exact boundary coefficients and nonexistence of a normalized decay limit are not routine implications of qualitative pointwise stability. Practical use is as a mathematically specified spectral-decay benchmark, not an assertion of broad downstream theorems.
